title: pvExtractCellsAlongLine
body:
## pvExtractCellsAlongLine

Extracts every cell of the input that the straight segment from Point1 to Point2 intersects and outputs those cells, with their point and cell data, as an unstructured grid. Use it to inspect the actual mesh cells crossed by a probe line, for example before plotting with probeLine; probeLine instead samples interpolated values at evenly spaced points. Use pvExtractCellsAlongLinesCustomSource for polylines or several lines.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Cells that only touch the line at a point or edge may or may not be counted; extend the segment slightly if boundary cells matter.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractCellsAlongLine`. Identity: `filters/ExtractCellsAlongLine`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

| `Point2` | This property controls the coordinates of the second endpoint of the line. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
